- Pulse Watch: four more apps (Water, Tip, Reaction, Convert). The watch app is small (about 1 MB) because it is a plain Wear OS app with no phone link and no heavy libraries.
- Game Hub native shelf: it ran out of memory with hundreds of games (every cover was held at once); only the games near the middle one are loaded now (smaller pictures too), and the native shelf is off by default again until it is finished.
- Crash fix: a Toolkit tool with a scrolling page of its own is measured with a height limit inside the Toolkit window (the infinite-height crash came back in 2.0.2).
